info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 共安排15項實驗，包含電學、磁學與光學之實驗，也介紹兩項基礎測量工具：三用電表與示波器。其中包含三項電腦化實驗，彌補了傳統儀器難以探討的主題。
description.describe_eh: There are 15 experiments in this course, including the topics of electricity, magnetism, and optics. The course also introduces two fundamental measuring tools required in electromagnetism. Meanwhile, the course contains three computer-sensing experiments. Take the advantage of the sophisticated sensor, the computer-aided data acquisition experiments enable students to investigate topics such as electromagnetic induction, which are hardly observed by traditional equipments.

targets.describe_en: Be familiar with the of basic circuit phenomena and their applications.

targets.describe_ch: 熟悉基本光學現象及其應用。
targets.describe_en: Be familiar with the basic Optical phenomena and their applications.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解基本電學、磁學及光的定律，並能應用解決機械問題。
targets.describe_en: Understand the basic laws of electricity, magnetism and optics, and be able to solve mechanical problems.
